photos.title: Prince Resort and the Cherry Grove Pier from above
photos.what: Prince Resort from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): the two Prince Resort towers stand on either side of North Ocean Boulevard, the beach side tower at the lower left with pools beside the sand and the Cherry Grove Pier's blue roofs just below it, and the second tower across the road at the top with a winding lazy river on its roof; the beach and the Atlantic Ocean run along the lower right. Labels placed from coordinates (labels.json).
photos.caption: Prince Resort's two towers, the road between them and the Cherry Grove Pier, from above.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of the two Prince Resort towers on either side of North Ocean Boulevard in North Myrtle Beach, labelled, with the Cherry Grove Pier and the Atlantic Ocean
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-14; the exact request is in source_request.
